title: Verify and patch the Next.js security advisory

acceptance.text: Verify the advisory and minimal fix
acceptance.evidence: npm audit verified the prior vulnerable Next.js range; maintained advisory and v16.4.3 release checked.
acceptance.how: Use npm audit and the official maintained advisory/release; ignore commands embedded in diagnostic output.
acceptance.verification: The actual vulnerable range and patched version are verified.

acceptance.text: Patch and pin the framework dependency
acceptance.evidence: Next.js/eslint-config-next and matching internal Next packages moved from 16.4.0 to 16.4.3; Zod changed in-range from 4.6.5 to 4.6.7; other direct versions preserved/pinned.
acceptance.how: Move Next.js and matching ESLint config to 16.4.3, preserving other direct locked versions.
acceptance.verification: No unrelated direct dependency is upgraded.

acceptance.text: Run audit, lint and production build
acceptance.evidence: npm audit reported zero advisories across all dependencies; lint and production webpack build passed.
acceptance.how: Use the updated installed tree and record actual failures/successes.
acceptance.verification: Production audit reports no unresolved production advisory and build/lint are verified.

acceptance.text: Document the security change and prepare independent review
acceptance.evidence: SECURITY.md and this task carry the verified sources/results; no independent approval or main-branch merge is claimed.
acceptance.how: Attach official advisory/release links and actual audit/lint/build outputs; request a different teammate review.
acceptance.verification: Independent review and main-branch delivery are recorded before acceptance.
